lines.en: Hello, this is Ahmed. Can I speak to Mr. Karim, please?
I'm sorry, he is in a meeting right now.
Can I leave a message for him?
Could you call me back this afternoon?
I can't hear you well. The line is bad.
Please speak a little more slowly.
I'll send you a message on WhatsApp.
Sorry, I have the wrong number.
My phone is about to die. I'll call you later.
Thanks for calling. Have a nice day.
